payload.body: Status has one home: the plan work item. On epic-vs-PRD status conflict, epic status wins; the PRD's prior status is preserved in the journal and the divergence noted (ADR-0013 amendment, Jim-approved during PR #13 round 2). Drift is only possible via --reopen revocation, guarded by the item.prd-unapproved validate warning. Epic-vs-children status rollup check remains a backlog chore (bktdg24r).
